instruction: Look at hard-11_left_grid.dxf, hard-11_right_grid.dxf. Create the hard AutoCAD drawing 'large datum-grid drilling jig' using exact model-space coordinates in millimeters. Straight geometry may be LINE entities or straight LWPOLYLINE edges; every listed rounded or slot end must be an ARC entity using the listed start/end angles in degrees. Required straight segments: OUTLINE (0,0)->(300,0); OUTLINE (300,0)->(300,180); OUTLINE (300,180)->(0,180); OUTLINE (0,180)->(0,0); CENTER (30,0)->(30,180); CENTER (78,0)->(78,180); CENTER (126,0)->(126,180); CENTER (174,0)->(174,180); CENTER (222,0)->(222,180); CENTER (270,0)->(270,180); CENTER (0,30)->(300,30); CENTER (0,70)->(300,70); CENTER (0,110)->(300,110); CENTER (0,150)->(300,150); CUTOUT (46,95)->(94,95); CUTOUT (46,85)->(94,85); CUTOUT (206,95)->(254,95); CUTOUT (206,85)->(254,85); CUTOUT (145,27)->(145,63); CUTOUT (155,27)->(155,63); CUTOUT (145,117)->(145,153); CUTOUT (155,117)->(155,153). Required circles: HOLE center (30,30) radius 4; HOLE center (30,70) radius 4; HOLE center (30,110) radius 4; HOLE center (30,150) radius 4; HOLE center (78,30) radius 4; HOLE center (78,70) radius 4; HOLE center (78,110) radius 4; HOLE center (78,150) radius 4; HOLE center (126,30) radius 4; HOLE center (126,70) radius 4; HOLE center (126,110) radius 4; HOLE center (126,150) radius 4; HOLE center (174,30) radius 4; HOLE center (174,70) radius 4; HOLE center (174,110) radius 4; HOLE center (174,150) radius 4; HOLE center (222,30) radius 4; HOLE center (222,70) radius 4; HOLE center (222,110) radius 4; HOLE center (222,150) radius 4; HOLE center (270,30) radius 4; HOLE center (270,70) radius 4; HOLE center (270,110) radius 4; HOLE center (270,150) radius 4. Required arcs: CUTOUT center (46,90) radius 5 start 90 end 270; CUTOUT center (94,90) radius 5 start 270 end 90; CUTOUT center (206,90) radius 5 start 90 end 270; CUTOUT center (254,90) radius 5 start 270 end 90; CUTOUT center (150,63) radius 5 start 0 end 180; CUTOUT center (150,27) radius 5 start 180 end 0; CUTOUT center (150,153) radius 5 start 0 end 180; CUTOUT center (150,117) radius 5 start 180 end 0. Required text strings: ANNOTATION text ACAD-H11; ANNOTATION text DATUM GRID 6X4. Export exactly one DXF deliverable named C:\Users\user\Desktop\autocad_result.dxf to the output folder. You must complete all operations interactively through the graphical user interface (GUI) step by step. The use of external script files is strictly prohibited.
